story.title: Story 1: Full Migration And Entity Coverage

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on prior blockers SV-01 and SV-02 plus directly touched migration/store/test surfaces. I confirmed generated rollout lookup no longer depends on loose JSON maps, confirmed migration retry reporting now distinguishes clean reruns from partial-state replacement, ran focused Story 1 tests, and ran the configured story gate.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved by SQLite-side target scanning that now includes projection identities. src/thread/store/sqlite-thread-store.ts:398-420 compares target identity keys, 1608-1678 scans thread.sqlite files and matches projection.generatedSessionId/generatedFilePath, and 985-1007 uses those SQLite matches before loose JSON map lookup. tests/thread/sqlite-thread-migration.test.ts:171-202 removes threadId-map.json and index.json, then verifies both original target and generated rollout target resolve to the migrated thread and resolveProjectionRevisionIdMap returns projection-001.

Resolved by explicit partial-state reporting before replacement. src/thread/migration/sqlite-thread-migration-service.ts:49-56 adds partialStateHandling to the migration result, 416-497 inspects existing SQLite counts and classifies clean_import, replaced_existing_import, or replaced_partial_state, and 552-565 returns that report. tests/thread/sqlite-thread-migration.test.ts:317-340 verifies complete rerun reporting, and 344-423 verifies an incomplete SQLite state is reported as replaced_partial_state before retry replacement restores all rows.

additionalObservations: Configured story gate passed: service suite reported 523 passing tests and e2e reported 15 passing tests.

No material fake adapter, shim, placeholder, or non-real production execution path was found in the quick-fix surfaces. The SQLite lookup fallback is an explicit managed-store lookup path aligned with TC-1.1c/TC-2.1c, and migration retry replacement is reported through the migration result rather than hidden.
